# Hand-drawn sketch

A thoughtful notebook feel, with deliberately clear information.

## Use

Use for workshop activities, early concepts, and collaborative learning guides.

## Essential traits

- Hand-marked accents
- Notebook rhythm
- Readable native text

## Typography

Georgia italic headings paired with system sans-serif body.

## Layout and surfaces

Notebook spacing, hand-marked accents, and short clear content groups. Slightly irregular outlines, ruled paper, and sketched emphasis.

## Palette

- background: #faf7e9
- surface: #fffdf5
- text: #343d42
- muted: #58646c
- accent: #335e7a
- border: #a6afb1

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Hand-drawn sketch to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia italic headings paired with system sans-serif body. Notebook spacing, hand-marked accents, and short clear content groups. Slightly irregular outlines, ruled paper, and sketched emphasis. Palette: background #faf7e9, surface #fffdf5, text #343d42, muted #58646c, accent #335e7a, border #a6afb1. Essential traits: Hand-marked accents; Notebook rhythm; Readable native text. Avoid: Unreadable script fonts; Excess scribbles; Roughness used as a substitute for structure. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
